{{Quote|I've been over the records again, and there's only one possible conclusion. C'baoth deliberately went beyond the battle plan Captain Aban had laid out&mdash;went beyond it to the point of disobeying a direct order.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Dark" />}}
The '''Taanab operation''' was a hit-and-fade attack carried out in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], during the [[Thrawn campaign]], by the forces of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. During the attack, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] took control of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Bellicose (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Bellicose'']] and used the ship's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to destroy a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ship against the orders of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Aban]].
